description:
AI Engineer
 Build AI solutions that move beyond experimentation and into production.
 We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our AI team supporting the Long-Term Care business at Manulife/John Hancock .
 In this role, you’ll build and scale production-grade AI solutions that improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, risk management, and business outcomes. You’ll work at the intersection of AI engineering, machine learning, Generative AI, data engineering, and full-stack development , partnering with Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Owners, and business teams to turn promising ideas and prototypes into reliable AI products.
 If you enjoy building with Python, Azure, Databricks, Azure OpenAI, MLflow, RAG, LLMs, and modern cloud technologies , while continuing to explore what’s next in AI, this could be a great opportunity for you.
 What you'll do
 Design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI and machine learning solutions .
 Turn Data Science and AI prototypes into reliable, maintainable production applications.
 Develop reusable ML and GenAI pipelines spanning data processing, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
 Build solutions using traditional machine learning techniques including classification, regression, forecasting, risk scoring, segmentation, and anomaly detection.
 Develop Generative AI and LLM applications using RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt orchestration, document intelligence, and intelligent workflow automation.
 Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices covering CI/CD, automated testing, model versioning, model registries, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
 Monitor production AI systems for model and data drift, accuracy, bias, latency, reliability, and cost.
 Build APIs, dashboards, and user-facing applications that integrate AI capabilities into business workflows.
 Work with Azure, Databricks, Azure OpenAI, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS , and other modern AI and cloud technologies.
 Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance, Security, Architecture, and Cloud teams to build AI responsibly in a regulated environment.
 Contribute to model governance, explainability, documentation, lineage, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
 Mentor junior engineers and data scientists on clean code, testing, production engineering, and MLOps/LLMOps best practices.
 What you bring
 3+ years of experience in AI Engineering, ML Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Science Engineering, or a related technical role.
 Strong Python development skills and experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code.
 Hands-on experience deploying AI or ML models into production cloud environments .
 Practical experience with MLOps , including CI/CD, model versioning, registries, automated testing, monitoring, and production support.
 Experience with GenAI and LLM solutions , including RAG, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, evaluation, and guardrails.
 Solid knowledge of traditional machine learning and predictive analytics techniques.
 Experience with cloud technologies, preferably Azure , and tools such as Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.
 Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured and unstructured data.
 Experience with data engineering technologies and concepts such as Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, ETL/ELT , data quality, and scalable pipelines.
 Full-stack experience, including building dashboards or frontend applications using technologies such as ReactJS .
 Strong software engineering fundamentals, including API design, unit and integration testing, code reviews, documentation, and secure development .
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
 Nice to have
 A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
 Advanced education in a relevant technical field.
 Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, Long-Term Care, claims, underwriting, risk management, or operations .
 Experience working with model governance, responsible AI, explainability, fairness testing , or AI in regulated environments.
 Experience with document intelligence, claims analytics, call-center analytics, knowledge management, or workflow automation.
 Experience with vector databases and search technologies such as Azure AI Search, Elasticsearch, Pinecone, or FAISS .
 Experience building production GenAI applications using orchestration frameworks, agentic AI patterns, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails .
 Why this opportunity?
 You’ll have the opportunity to work on AI solutions with meaningful real-world applications while solving the engineering challenges required to take AI from prototype to production .
 You’ll collaborate across AI, Data, Product, Technology, and Business teams, work with a modern cloud and AI stack, and help shape how AI is responsibly designed, deployed, monitored, and scaled within the organization.
 If you're curious, hands-on, and excited about building AI products that actually make it into production , we'd love to hear from you.
 
 The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.
 
 About Manulife and John Hancock 
 
 Manulife Financial Corporation is a leading international financial services provider, helping people make their decisions easier and lives better. To learn more about us, visit https://www.manulife.com/en/about/our-story.html .
 
 Manulife is an Equal Opportunity Employer 
 
 At Manulife/John Hancock, we embrace our diversity. We strive to attract, develop and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to foster an inclusive work environment that embraces the strength of cultures and individuals. We are committed to fair recruitment, retention, advancement and compensation, and we administer all of our practices and programs without discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, religion or religious beliefs, creed, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions), sexual orientation, genetic characteristics, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, or any other ground protected by applicable law.
 
 It is our priority to remove barriers to provide equal access to employment. A Human Resources representative will work with applicants who request a reasonable accommodation during the application process. All information shared during the accommodation request process will be stored and used in a manner that is consistent with applicable laws and Manulife/John Hancock policies. To request a reasonable accommodation in the application process, contact hr@manulife.com .

Boston, Massachusetts

 Employees also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn incentive compensation tied to business and individual performance. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location, please contact hr@manulife.com for the salary range for your location.

 Manulife/John Hancock offers eligible employees a wide array of customizable benefits, including health, dental, mental health, vision, short- and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance coverage, adoption/surrogacy and wellness benefits, and employee/family assistance plans. We also offer eligible employees various retirement savings plans (including pension/401(k) savings plans and a global share ownership plan with employer matching contributions) and financial education and counseling resources. Our generous paid time off program in the U.S. includes up to 11 paid holidays, 3 personal days, 150 hours of vacation, and 40 hours of sick time (or more where required by law) each year, and we offer the full range of statutory leaves of absence.
 
 We use data and analytics technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI), and automated processing tools, to analyze and process the information you provide to us or third parties in the application process. For more information, please refer to our personal information collection statement .
